reviews.title: Exactly what I ordered
reviews.comment: This memory was used to upgrade my system to 32 gigs of ram. I had 2 8 gig sticks and needed a perfect match to what I already had. These were perfect as described. No issues at all. New memory recognized on startup. Entered bios to update. Smooth transition. Now running XMP 2.0. Thanks. Product was exactly as advertised and came quicker than expected for delivery. Nice quality.
